EntityProps.Name: CUSTOMER
EntityProps.Comment:
The role of the Party that takes title to purchased goods or services purchased from Shell. It includes prospect customers too. In Shell context a B2B Customer is reserved for business organizations or persons, including retail stores, but excluding end consumers (e.g.people buying petrol/gasoline to put in their vehicle) that purchase a product for their own use in the pursuit of its business. Customers may use the products for a variety of reasons (e.g. manufacturing, transport, heating, etc) or on-sell them to others and are invoiced directly by Shell for goods and services. Customers can also include intermediaries such as dealers and distributors who on-sell to consumers or other intermediaries. Although a customer is typically an organisation which buys from Shell, the seller in that transaction can also be a Shell company (eg Shell Italy can sell a product to Shell France, and that transaction can incur a tax liability).Technically a Customer is denoted based on a 1-1 relationship with a CUSTOMER_SOLD_TO entity, which represents the Account and interaction with the Shell sales organisation.
